summary:
Public Law 119-9 (H.J. Res. 75) provides for congressional disapproval, pursuant to chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code (the Congressional Review Act), of a rule submitted by the Department of Energy's Office of Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy. The disapproved rule, titled "Energy Conservation Program: Energy Conservation Standards for Commercial Refrigerators, Freezers, and Refrigerator-Freezers," was published at 90 Federal Register 7464 on January 21, 2025. 

The joint resolution's sole operative provision enacts Congress's disapproval of the specified rule and provides that such rule shall have no force or effect. The joint resolution was approved by the President on May 9, 2025.
